# Brutal Slayer

Internal ID: THSwordSlayerBlood | Type: Sword | Source: Black forge | Usage: Weapon | Wielding: Two-handed | Crafting Materials: Flametal x45, Bloodstone x3 | Attack speed: 2.16 s | Chain last hit: 2x damage, +20% knockback | Hitbox: 3 range, 30 angle, 1.0 height, 0.5 ray | Movement speed: -5%

# Introduction

Brutal Slayer is the upgraded form of Slayer using the Bloodstone. Like all upgraded-weapons that use Bloodstone, their hit effect is damage increased by 0.2% for every point of health the player is missing (not the percentage missing).
An upgraded Slayer will NOT keep its upgrade level when it is modified using gemstones.

## Upgrade information

• stat: Slash | Quality 1: 170 | Quality 2: 176 | Quality 3: 182 | Quality 4: 188

• stat: Durability | Quality 1: 200 | Quality 2: 250 | Quality 3: 300 | Quality 4: 350

• stat: Crafting | Quality 1: 1 Slayer15 Flametal1 Bloodstone | Quality 2: 15 Flametal1 Bloodstone | Quality 3: 30 Flametal2 Bloodstone | Quality 4: 45 Flametal3 Bloodstone

• stat: Black forge level | Quality 1: 4 | Quality 2: 5 | Quality 3: 6 (not yet available) | Quality 4: 7 (not yet available)

## Notes

• The primary attacks are fairly vertical and wide-reaching, with the third attack in the combo being more narrow in the horizontal plane.
• The secondary attack is a long reaching thrust that is capable of outreaching most enemies with very excellent damage.
• The Bloodstone effect works with MISSING health, -1 Health = 0.2% increased damage.

Categorias: Weapons, Swords, Black forge recipes
